scope: Spec and code-quality review of extraction.py, layout.py, candidates.py and Task 2 tests; pipeline metadata persistence was inspected at the integration boundary. Cache counts are not accuracy evidence.

findings.title: Independent tables overwrite each other's specimen context
findings.evidence: side_by_side_context fixture: left specimen label explicitly says URINE and right says BLOOD on the same y row. Both columns contain GLU. Both observations are emitted as LAB_FASTING_GLUCOSE, specimen BLOOD, capability STABLE and no quality issues. The left field_evidence.specimen polygon points to the right-hand BLOOD label (x=.53).
findings.cause: specimen/panel/specimen_source are page-global variables overwritten as regions are visited, then reused for every template in the row.
findings.impact: A urine observation receives the identity and provenance of a different blood table without any uncertainty gate. This is a cross-source identity error, not merely a display omission.
findings.requested_change: Scope specimen/panel evidence to independent table regions, inherit only compatible table-scoped continuation context, and leave conflicting or unassignable context unresolved with a quality reason. Also ensure a context-only cell in one table does not suppress data cells in another table on the same physical row.
findings.regression_expectation: The left GLU must retain URINE context with its own label source or stay an explicitly uncertain candidate; it must never be silently mapped using the right BLOOD label.

findings.title: An OCR cell overlapping two item rows is greedily published for the first row
findings.evidence: cross_row_region fixture: HGB name/unit occupy y=.20-.225; MCHC name/unit occupy y=.24-.265; numeric 330 occupies y=.21-.265, overlapping both. Extraction publishes HGB=330 g/L as STABLE with quality_issues=[] and marks only MCHC as missing.
findings.cause: _rows sorts by top edge and irrevocably attaches a value to an already-seen row before a competing lower item anchor is processed. The later association pass has no record that this region matches two rows.
findings.impact: A neighboring item's or ambiguous value can be assigned as a trusted HGB result even though the source geometry does not uniquely establish that association.
findings.requested_change: Build item/row anchors before committing result cells, or perform a second ambiguity pass across complete rows. Preserve overlapping candidates and mark affected associations SEARCH_ONLY rather than committing to the first row.
findings.regression_expectation: The 330 region must not yield trusted HGB=330. Competing row associations must remain explicit candidates with an association_conflict reason.

findings.title: Cross-column evidence is trusted when its left edge is near one header
findings.evidence: cross_column_region fixture: headers are result x=.3 and reference x=.5; a numeric 130 OCR box runs x=.3-.65 and covers both columns. Extraction emits HGB=130 g/L as STABLE with no quality issue.
findings.cause: Column/table assignment and ambiguity checks use only the region's left coordinate. The full polygon crossing another field/table boundary is ignored.
findings.impact: A broad or merged OCR source region can be treated as a precise result-field association even when it could be reference text or a merged cell. The current midpoint-left-edge test does not cover this case.
findings.requested_change: Use region extent/overlap against column and table areas, and explicitly degrade genuinely multi-column cells unless their field boundaries are independently established.
findings.regression_expectation: A region covering both result and reference columns must not be admitted as an unqualified STABLE result.

"""Synthetic review probes; run from repo root with python .runtime/task2-review-probe.py."""
import os
import sys
import json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
os.environ['DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE']='config.settings.test'
import django
django.setup()
from dataclasses import replace
from apps.labs.dictionary import load_dictionary
from apps.labs.extraction import extract_observations
from apps.processing.value_objects import OcrRegion
from tests.labs.test_phase_two_layout import page

def fixtures():
    contexts=page([
        (.05,[(.03,'\u6807\u672c\uff1a\u5c3f\u6db2'),(.53,'\u6807\u672c\uff1a\u5168\u8840')]),
        (.1,[(.03,'item'),(.2,'result'),(.32,'unit'),(.53,'item'),(.7,'result'),(.82,'unit')]),
        (.2,[(.03,'GLU'),(.2,'5.2'),(.32,'mmol/L'),(.53,'GLU'),(.7,'6.2'),(.82,'mmol/L')]),
    ])
    columns=page([
        (.1,[(.05,'item'),(.3,'result'),(.5,'reference'),(.8,'unit')]),
        (.2,[(.05,'HGB'),(.3,'130'),(.8,'g/L')]),
    ])
    regions=list(columns.regions)
    regions[5]=replace(regions[5],polygon=((.3,.2),(.65,.2),(.65,.225),(.3,.225)))
    columns=replace(columns,regions=tuple(regions))
    rows=page([
        (.1,[(.05,'item'),(.4,'result'),(.7,'unit')]),
        (.2,[(.05,'HGB'),(.7,'g/L')]),
        (.24,[(.05,'MCHC'),(.7,'g/L')]),
    ])
    overlapping_value=OcrRegion('330',((.4,.21),(.47,.21),(.47,.265),(.4,.265)),.99,7)
    rows=replace(rows,regions=(*rows.regions,overlapping_value))
    return {'side_by_side_context':contexts,'cross_column_region':columns,'cross_row_region':rows}

if __name__=='__main__':
    dictionary=load_dictionary(Path('apps/labs/dictionaries/phase-two.json'))
    output={}
    for name,source in fixtures().items():
        items=extract_observations((source,),dictionary)
        output[name]=[{
            'name':item.raw_name,'code':item.standard_code,'value':item.raw_value,
            'unit':item.raw_unit,'specimen':item.specimen,'capability':item.capability_level,
            'issues':[issue['code'] for issue in item.quality_issues],
            'specimen_source':item.field_evidence.get('specimen'),
        } for item in items]
    print(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
